record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The four units in appliesTo declare SLUDGE in this production reference (all with passive NONE in the catalog, maxPP 100, range 1). The strategy is shared; differences are star count (1 or 2) and stats.
record.summary: Applies poison to every enemy standing in the three cells directly in front of the caster (towards its target): the strategy requests 2/3/4/8 poison stacks by stars with a duration of 3000/3000/3000/10000 ms scaled by AP (and crit power only if the cast crit). Each request is one triggerPoison call that adds one stack up to a cap of 3 (4 with VENOMOUS, 5 with TOXIC on the caster), so the requested stack count is higher than what can be applied for 1- and 2-star casters. No direct damage; the poison then deals TRUE damage each second.

targeting.who: enemy units in the cells returned by board.getCellsInFront(caster, target): up to three adjacent cells (the cast target's direction and its two neighbouring orientations, range 1). The target itself need not be hit unless it stands in one of those cells.
targeting.note: getCellsInFront also sets the caster's orientation towards the target as a side effect. The orientation function itself was not read; cells outside the board are dropped.

geometry.shape: the three cells adjacent to the caster in the cast direction (front and the two neighbouring orientations, range 1); only occupied cells holding an enemy (different team) are affected

effects.scaling: the strategy deals no damage itself; see statusEffects.0 for the requested vs applied stacks and duration, and for the per-second tick
effects.resolution: applied stacks are capped by triggerPoison (3 / 4 VENOMOUS / 5 TOXIC); tick damage = round(5% maxHP x stacks) with listed reductions, TRUE damage, at least 1

statusEffects.target: each enemy in the front cells
statusEffects.scaling: requested duration = round(raw x (1 + AP/100) x (critPower if the cast crit)); the crit flag is rolled only if the caster has the ABILITY_CRIT effect (SLUDGE is not canCritByDefault). The stack count is not scaled by AP or crit.
statusEffects.applicationOrder: after super.process, per cell in the order returned (a Set of coordinates), per enemy: nbStacks successive triggerPoison calls
statusEffects.guards: no stack at all if the target has IMMUNITY_POISON or runeProtect. Each call adds one stack with max(maxStacks) where maxStacks is 3, or 4 if the caster has VENOMOUS, or 5 if the caster has TOXIC; so requested stacks beyond the cap change nothing (applied stacks = min(existing + requested, cap)). Each call passes the duration through applyStatusDurationReductions (SWIFT_SWIM x0.7, HYDRATION x0.5, WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER x0.3, then -10% per ODD_KEYSTONE in the target player's items, rounded) and the timer is replaced only if longer. Each call also sets poisonOrigin to the caster. GUTS / TOXIC_BOOST passives on the target gain attack on first stack; a PECHA_BERRY holder eats the berry.
statusEffects.combatEffect: while poisonStacks > 0 the status ticks every 1000 ms: damage = round(maxHP x 5% x stacks), reduced by RAIN weather (x0.7), ASSAULT_VEST (x0.5), TOXIC_BOOST passive (x0.5) and SWIFT_SWIM (x0.7) / HYDRATION (x0.5) / WATER_VEIL or SURGE_SURFER (x0.3); GLISCOR counts stacks - 2 (and heals if negative). It is dealt as TRUE damage through handleDamage with at least 1, attacker = the last poisonOrigin, no mana gain. When the timer runs out all stacks are removed.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3-star (4 stacks, 3000 ms) and 4-star (8 stacks, 10000 ms) entries are not reachable by the listed units' bare star counts (1 and 2). With the default cap of 3 stacks the requested 2 or 3 stacks fit the cap on a fresh target; on a target already carrying stacks the cap limits the sum.

record.positionalConditions: The affected cells depend on the caster-to-target direction; only enemies standing in those three cells are poisoned. The unit must be in range of its target to cast (requiresTarget is true).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast adds more stacks (up to the cap) and refreshes the duration only if longer; poisonOrigin becomes the latest caster.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: 2 (1 star) or 3 (2 stars) poison stacks with 3000 ms raw duration. Applied: duration x (1 + AP/100) [x critPower on crit], rounded, then reduced by target-side status duration reductions; stacks per target = min(existing stacks + requested, 3 / 4 VENOMOUS / 5 TOXIC), none against poison immunity or rune protection. The damage is the later poison tick: round(5% maxHP x stacks) TRUE damage per second with the listed reductions, at least 1.
